summary: Defines the Session Description Protocol (SDP), a text format for describing multimedia sessions for announcement, invitation and other forms of session initiation. It tells endpoints what media to exchange and how to reach each other. It obsoletes RFC 4566 and is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Before a call begins, each side hands the other a short note saying what it can send and where. SDP is the format of that note, so every device can read it.

questions: what does session description protocol do
